description: In crates/core/src/rate_limiter.rs, when eviction fires (every 1024 calls or at MAX_ENTRIES), the entire HashMap is scanned under the write-lock while holding it, blocking all concurrent rate-limit checks. Under a DDoS with 65536 entries the scan is O(65536) while other tasks wait. Fix: either (a) swap expired entries to a secondary structure and evict lazily per-entry outside the lock, or (b) use a two-level LRU/clock structure so eviction is O(1) amortized. At minimum document the lock hold time so operators know the worst-case latency.
title: rate_limiter: eviction holds write-lock for full O(n) HashMap scan
